The '''E-2T medical shuttle''', also known as the '''E-2T medshuttle''', was a fast [[Shuttle/Legends|ambulance]] craft used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to carry wounded [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] away during battle. Several of these ships were stationed on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]]. The shuttle had limited [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] capability and generally carried a crew of six on board, with facilities to transport and maintain twelve more [[Human/Legends|Human]]-sized patients. The shuttle was unarmed and marked as noncombat medical transport, meaning that neither the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] or the Empire would fire on it.<ref name="Death Star" />

One such shuttle, numbered [[5537]], was hijacked by Imperial defectors [[Celot Ratua Dil]], [[Memah Roothes]], [[Kornell Divini]], [[Villian Dance]], and [[Teela Kaarz]] as they escaped the Death Star before it was destroyed at the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="Death Star" />
